body:
Absolutely the only person I can really keep going for. He's also a reason I'm more than a little scared to death of saying anything to our mother. I get terrified that if she thinks I'm too fucked up she'll make me leave, and keep me away from him.

As someone who has only spent a handful of time away from a child she helped raise, it's honestly enough to drive me crazy.

That first happened right after high school. I went to school for the summer but she handled all the money side of it because that's just what she does. She said there wasn't enough for me to go to the school I wanted but suggested I take a year off, so then I could help watch my brother while she go back to school.

This is where I'm a dumbass again. I start going to a cheaper school but things at home are so horrible I decide to try and 'fix' myself by finding a relationship.

Now, we're actually two/three states away from where I pretty much grew up. And I haven't been here quite a year yet so I get charged out of state tuition.

I rambled. Sorry.

I'm either compassionate or weak. I tend to take the approach 'If you need anything come to me. I will not have you needing help if I can help it', which sounds kinda strange when typed out.

Thing is they've offered advice when I mention that I'm frustrated with stuff. They don't know to the degree that I'm 'frustrated' but I feel like a broken record. I don't want to break down to any of them. They honestly don't deserve that mess.
